usearazzo-runner.name: UseArazzo runner
usearazzo-runner.notes: A library with no CLI; scripts/usearazzo-run.mjs calls ArazzoRunner.load and execute.

libopenapi.name: libopenapi arazzo engine
libopenapi.notes: The library leaves HTTP to the caller, so scripts/libopenapi-arazzo carries a minimal executor. ExecutionRequest passes parameters by name only, without their `in`, so that executor places each one where the source OpenAPI operation declares it; a parameter the operation does not declare cannot be placed.

cases.rule: a step output feeds the next step's path parameter
replacements overwrite the payload at a JSON Pointer before sending
a query parameter is sent on the request
a header parameter is sent on the request
an unmet successCriteria fails the step and the workflow, and nothing after it runs
a simple condition can compare a response body value
a false body comparison fails the workflow
a regex criterion that does not match fails the workflow
a jsonpath filter over an object body, read the way the spec example reads
cases.note: Not scored. The spec example $[?count(@.pets) > 0] applies a filter to the root object itself; RFC 9535 applies a filter to the children of the root. A runner that follows one reading passes one of these two cases and fails the other.

cases.rule: a jsonpath filter over an array body, read the way RFC 9535 reads
cases.note: Not scored. The spec example $[?count(@.pets) > 0] applies a filter to the root object itself; RFC 9535 applies a filter to the children of the root. A runner that follows one reading passes one of these two cases and fails the other.

cases.rule: onSuccess end stops the workflow after the step
onSuccess goto jumps over the steps between
onFailure retry repeats the step until it succeeds
cases.note: The mock answers a pet named flaky with 404 once, then 200.

cases.rule: retryLimit 2 means two retries after the first attempt, then the step fails
cases.note: The spec: retryLimit is "how many attempts to retry the step may be attempted before failing", so 1 + 2 requests.

cases.rule: onFailure goto runs the recovery step
cases.note: Whether a workflow that recovered counts as a success is not stated, so only the requests are judged.

cases.rule: a step can run another workflow and use its outputs
